headline: Kalyan Jewellers shares surge 16% following strong quarterly results
hook: Strong festive demand fuels record stock highs
summary: Kalyan Jewellers reported a 31% revenue increase and 64% net profit growth for the September quarter, driven by festive demand and market share gains. The company added 11 stores during the quarter, bringing its total network to 365, and maintains a 25% revenue growth guidance for FY27. Analysts have raised earnings estimates, citing improved profitability and successful expansion into non-South Indian markets. The stock reached a 52-week high following the announcement.
whats_next: December quarter performance and store expansion progress
why_it_matters: Organised jewellery retailers continue gaining market share from local shops.
winners_losers: Kalyan Jewellers gains / Unorganised jewellers hurt

Retail investors holding shares in the jewellery sector should monitor how these expansion plans translate into quarterly revenue numbers. Strong retail footfalls during festive periods often provide a boost to top-line earnings for established jewellery chains.
